finding: Both datasets yield identical observed count (187 within 50km). The extra ~11K sites in 36,693 dataset contribute nothing near the circle.

dataset_a.notes: Used in Papers 1 and 2 as originally published. Different deduplication: lat/lon-based rather than SiteID-based.

dataset_b.notes: More complete dataset; used in land-constrained MC (Task 1). Same 187 observed because additional sites are all >50km from circle.

recommendation: Use dataset_b (36,693 sites) for merged paper because: (1) it is the version that has a land-constrained Z-score computed; (2) it is more complete; (3) the observed count is identical so results are directly comparable. Report Z=7.77 (unconstrained) and Z=2.09 (land-constrained). Note that Paper 1 used 25,557 sites (different processing).
key_point: The land-constrained Z=2.09 is the figure to use in the merged paper. p=0.02 is marginal — explicitly note this. The unconstrained Z=7.77 is inflated by coastal jitter bias.
implication: p3k14c shows only marginal enrichment after land-constraint correction (Z=2.09, p=0.02). This is an important methodological finding and should be reported honestly.
